root_cause_analysis.question: Why is search impression share 0.00% rather than merely low?
root_cause_analysis.eliminated_1_keyword_eligibility: NOT the cause. 'gas boiler repair' Phrase and Exact are both status ENABLED, system_serving_status ELIGIBLE, approval_status APPROVED.
root_cause_analysis.eliminated_2_negatives: NOT the cause. Zero campaign negatives, zero ad-group negatives, no negative list attached to the campaign. The account-level negative list 11252984411 holds 59 BROAD members and none of them blocks 'gas boiler repair'.
root_cause_analysis.eliminated_3_policy: NOT the cause. Campaign ENABLED and SERVING; ad group 202339087594 ENABLED; both ENABLED RSAs (821319509209, 821319509212) APPROVED, REVIEWED, ad strength EXCELLENT, no policy topics.
root_cause_analysis.eliminated_4_ad_disapproval_window: NOT the current cause. The originals were disapproved until 2026-08-18 15:17, but in the clean window since then the campaign still recorded zero impressions.
root_cause_analysis.eliminated_5_budget: NOT the cause. Budget-lost impression share is 0.00% and the campaign has never spent any of its $42.76 daily budget.
root_cause_analysis.eliminated_6_ad_schedule: NOT the cause going forward. Package A removed the campaign schedule on 2026-08-19, so the campaign is now eligible 24/7. Before that it was still eligible 65 hours a week and recorded nothing.
root_cause_analysis.CONFIRMED_CAUSE: SEARCH VOLUME. 'gas boiler repair' averages 10 searches per month across the 10 core service-area cities, which is Google's minimum reported bucket, so true volume is at or below 10 per month. The broader head term 'boiler repair' is only 30 per month in the same geography. With Presence-only targeting across 75 tight local targets, English only, and Phrase/Exact match on a boiler-specific phrase, an expected count of well under one query per day makes zero impressions across 19 days the statistically ordinary outcome, not an anomaly.
root_cause_analysis.corroboration: search_term_view returned ZERO rows for this campaign since launch. Not low-performing terms, no terms at all. Google never matched a single query.
root_cause_analysis.implication: Impression share is undefined-as-zero because the denominator, eligible impressions, is itself zero. No budget change can move a metric whose denominator is zero.

maximum_daily_overdelivery.rule: Google may spend up to 2x a campaign's daily budget on a single day.
maximum_daily_overdelivery.honest_statement: Even at Stage 1 the arithmetic worst case of $14612.43 exceeds the $13,000 cap. Google's monthly charging limit is computed per campaign and is recalculated when a budget changes mid-month, so Google does not enforce a $13,000 account-level cap. Observed demand makes the worst case unreachable, but the daily guardrail above is what actually enforces the cap and it must be run.

cpc_ceiling_proposal.instruction: A Maximize Clicks CPC ceiling was to be proposed only if historical conversion rate, qualified-lead data or a target CPL supports a defensible maximum. No number is invented here.

evidence_missing.qualified_lead_data: NOT AVAILABLE - no CRM or closed-won feed reaches Google Ads, and both WhatConverts upload actions have recorded zero conversions all-time

cpc_ceiling_proposal.why_not_proposed: A maximum CPC is target CPL multiplied by conversion rate. A conversion rate exists, but no target CPL, target CPQL, job value, margin or close rate exists anywhere in the client record. Deriving a ceiling would mean inventing the target CPL, which is exactly what was ruled out. A further caution: the 5.47% rate comes from legacy Search campaigns with different keywords and different landing pages, so applying it to these five would itself be an assumption.
cpc_ceiling_proposal.correction_to_earlier_analysis: The rejected package EF9FBA55926545F2 described the current $43.05 average CPC as evidence of bid inflation. That framing was wrong. This account's own Search channel averaged $50.14 per click over the trailing year before launch, and the keyword planner puts top-of-page bids for 'ac repair near me' at $19.94 to $94.04 and 'hvac repair near me' at $23.32 to $107.10 in this geography. $43.05 is below the account's own recent Search norm and inside the market range. High CPC here is the market, not a bidding error.

derivation_available_on_one_input.reading: A ceiling that merely matches the trailing-year CPA sits near $50.10, which is ABOVE the current $43.05 blended CPC and would barely bind. A ceiling that actually restrains spend needs a target CPL below roughly $790. Supply one number, a target CPL or an acceptable CPA, and a defensible ceiling follows immediately.

cpc_ceiling_proposal.risk_of_guessing: A ceiling set below the market top-of-page range would not reduce cost per lead. It would stop delivery on the only campaign that is currently working.
